user.description: Select your country and type your city or postal code to search for nearby Lidl stores. Optionally check the box below to log in to Lidl Plus for coupons and receipts.

data.country: Country Code (e.g., DE, AT, BE, ES, FR, NL, PL)

login.description:
Enter your Lidl Plus email/phone number and password. The integration will attempt automatic login.

If automatic login fails (e.g. due to Captcha protection), you will be directed to Web Login / Token entry.

mfa.description: A verification code has been sent to your registered phone or email. Please enter it below.

manual_token.description:
Automatic login was blocked (Captcha protection).

**Option A — Automatic Web Login:**
1. [Click here to open the Lidl Plus login page]({login_url})
2. Log in with your credentials — the browser will automatically send the code back to Home Assistant.
3. You will see "Login successful" in the browser and can close the tab.

**Option B — CLI:**
Run `npx lidl-plus-auth` in your terminal and paste the token below.

web_auth.description:
**Step 1:** [Click here to open the Lidl Plus login page]({login_url})

**Step 2:** Log in with your credentials and complete MFA if prompted.

**Step 3:** After login the browser will redirect automatically. You will see "Login successful" and Home Assistant will capture the token automatically.

⏳ Home Assistant is waiting up to 5 minutes for the callback.
